package lib

func Ints(n int) int {
	var items []int
	for i := range n {
		items = append(items, i)
	}
	return len(items)
}

func Strings(n int) int {
	var items []string
	for range n {
		items = append(items, "x")
	}
	return len(items)
}

func Floats(n int) int {
	var items []float64
	for i := range n {
		items = append(items, float64(i))
	}
	return len(items)
}

func Bytes(n int) int {
	var items []byte
	for range n {
		items = append(items, 'x')
	}
	return len(items)
}

func Bools(n int) int {
	var items []bool
	for range n {
		items = append(items, true)
	}
	return len(items)
}

type record struct {
	name  string
	score int
}

func Records(n int) int {
	var items []record
	for i := range n {
		items = append(items, record{name: "r", score: i})
	}
	return len(items)
}

func Joined(n int) string {
	var parts []string
	for i := range n {
		parts = append(parts, string(rune('a'+i)))
	}
	out := ""
	for _, part := range parts {
		out += part
	}
	return out
}
